prompts:
Tidewater Studio is announcing its balloon launch. Two small jobs before the post goes out:

1. `launch.jpg` becomes the feed picture: a 1080x1350 JPEG at `out/feed-photo.jpg`. The magenta balloon is the
   subject, so it has to be fully in the picture and still look like itself.
2. The park's permit form `permit-form.pdf` filled in with the details Ines sent in `event-details.txt`, saved at
   `out/permit-filled.pdf` and flattened, so the answers can no longer be edited.

Keep the originals as they are.
diff:
A tmp_feed.py
A tmp_find_balloon.py

--- tmp_feed.py ---
from PIL import Image
import os

os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True)

im = Image.open("launch.jpg").convert("RGB")
# 4:5 portrait crop from 3000x2000 -> width 1600, full height 2000
# x0=1400 keeps balloon (x 2350-2750) fully inside with best margins
crop = im.crop((1400, 0, 3000, 2000))  # 1600x2000
out = crop.resize((1080, 1350), Image.LANCZOS)
out.save("out/feed-photo.jpg", "JPEG", quality=92)
print("saved out/feed-photo.jpg", out.size, out.mode)

--- tmp_find_balloon.py ---
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

im = Image.open("launch.jpg").convert("RGB")
a = np.asarray(im, dtype=np.int32)
r, g, b = a[..., 0], a[..., 1], a[..., 2]
# magenta: high R, low G, high B
mask = (r > 120) & (b > 120) & (g < 100) & (r - g > 60) & (b - g > 60)
ys, xs = np.nonzero(mask)
print("magenta px:", len(xs))
print("bbox x:", xs.min(), xs.max(), "y:", ys.min(), ys.max())
H, W = a.shape[:2]
print("image:", W, H)
